experiment.name: Balanced Retrieval Trajectory and Attention Pilot
experiment.research_object: Four-layer Transformer on shortcut-free one-hop retrieval

hypotheses.primary: After shortcut-free retrieval is reliably learned, ordered layer-state history improves future-flip prediction beyond current, dimension-matched, shuffled, and sample-mismatched controls.
hypotheses.attention: Ordered attention-summary history improves prediction beyond current state plus current attention and matched attention-history controls.
hypotheses.secondary: Ordered state and attention histories improve prediction of future reduction in negative log-likelihood.
hypotheses.null: Historical features add no stable predictive information after current state and current attention are available.

interpretation_boundary: Probe improvements establish incremental decodability under the stated controls; they do not by themselves establish causal use or metacognition.
